lines.zh: 脚尖点着空气，我滑出去。
lines.en: I ride the air on my toes.
Small frame, and I turn faster than most.

lines.zh: 我浮在离地一尺的地方。
lines.en: I float a foot above the ground.
This place is too tight for my footwork.
My boots never touch the ground.
One step, two, and I circle.
Small as I am, speed is mine.
I walk along the edge of the wind.
There is no rival in a place like this.
I walk and look for a mirror.
Hair must not be messy; I smooth it.
On tiptoe, I drift across.
I raise a hand to check my nails.
Such idleness is a waste.
I hang with my toes pointed down.
Wait, let me fix my collar.

lines.zh: 这星球连个像样的对手都没有。
lines.en: This planet lacks a single decent opponent.
I hum a few bars.

lines.zh: 转个身，看看披风飘得好不好。
lines.en: I turn to see how the cape falls.
My body is more limber than yours.
It is a little cold here.

lines.zh: 我在想一个漂亮的开场。
lines.en: I am composing a fine entrance.

lines.zh: 手指在空气里划了一圈。
lines.en: My finger draws a circle in the air.
Standing this long has stiffened my legs.
I settle lightly onto a stone.

lines.zh: 镜子里要是能照出我多好。
lines.en: If only something here could show my reflection.

lines.zh: 你比我高，但高不是本事。
lines.en: You are taller, and height is not skill.
Your stance is too heavy.
Your boots would announce you.
I have seen plenty of your type.

lines.zh: 别紧张，我不会一下子结束。
lines.en: Do not fret; I will not end it at once.

lines.zh: 你的站姿太重了，转身会很慢。
lines.en: Your stance is heavy; you will turn slowly.
Your eyes follow me around.
Cannot keep up, can you?
I am not something you can touch.
Your clothes have no taste at all.

lines.zh: 你连站的地方都选错了。
lines.en: You even picked the wrong spot to stand.
I am looking at your knees.

lines.zh: 膝盖一软，就没什么可看了。
lines.en: Once the knees give, there is nothing left to see.
You are measuring the distance.
You measured wrong.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，别装作镇定。
lines.en: Your breath is off; stop pretending calm.
Let me show you a smile.
Are you worth my effort?

lines.zh: 我踉跄了一下，稳住身形。
lines.en: I stumble, then catch my balance.
You actually landed that.
My hem is torn; I frown.
That blow had no elegance.
Half a step back, and my foot slips.
It hurts; I will not deny it.
My clothes are wrinkled; let me smooth them first.
You got lucky.
I roll my shoulder.
My next kick will be heavier.
You offer such coarse food to me?
Held that far off, as if I would snatch it.
I am not hungry, though a little thirsty.

lines.zh: 你要是懂事，就先递上来。
lines.en: If you have manners, hand it up to me.

lines.zh: 这点东西，连盘子都不配。
lines.en: This does not even deserve a plate.
One small taste, only one.

lines.zh: 味道一般，不过心意可嘉。
lines.en: Mediocre, but the thought is kind.

lines.zh: 我吃东西的姿势很好看。
lines.en: I eat beautifully, you know.
Stop staring or I will laugh.
Take it away; I am done.

lines.zh: 小心点，别弄皱我的衣服。
lines.en: Careful; do not crease my clothes.
You bumped me; I gave half a step.
Our footing is not the same.

lines.zh: 我这身小个子，全靠连踢。
lines.en: Small as I am, I fight with kicks.
A little space, thank you.
I am this light and you still hit me?
Do not touch my hair.

lines.zh: 我的披风是新的，脚下留情。
lines.en: My cape is new; watch your feet.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，动作很漂亮。
lines.en: I slip aside, and it looks good.
Try again; I will dodge faster.

lines.zh: 这种话题，配不上我的品味。
lines.en: Such a topic is beneath my taste.
I discuss that only with the strong.
Win a round first, then we talk.
Do not look at me like that.

lines.zh: 别浪费我的时间，也别碰我头发。
lines.en: Don't waste my time, and don't touch my hair.

lines.zh: 这种事会弄乱我的发型。
lines.en: That would ruin my hair.
I do fine on my own.
Your smile has even less taste.
We are not the same kind.
Change the subject, quickly.
Did this fall? I am taking it.
It is dirty; let me wipe it.
This suits my boots.
Whoever dropped it may speak to me.
I pick it up by the corner.
A trifle, but it shines.
In my pocket; can you tell?
Lying on the ground is so unbecoming.
I hold it up to the light.
It is mine; do not argue.
You, stand right there.
I have you locked.
One kick and I am at your face.
Did you just smile?
Laughing at my height?

lines.zh: 我让你看看什么叫速度。
lines.en: Let me show you what speed means.

lines.zh: 你的位置很好，适合开场。
lines.en: Your position is good for an opening.
I dislike dragging things out.
This clearing is my stage.
I will borrow your knees first.
Backing away will not help.
I count to two.
One.
Before two, you are down.
My toe has already turned toward you.
Do not blink.

lines.zh: 我在你左边，又到了右边。
lines.en: Left of you, now right.
You turn too slowly.
My landing makes a single sound.
You cannot hear my steps.
My toes hover off the ground, ready to kick.
The raise is the slowest part.
The opening is at your waist.
I circle around your shadow.
You step back and I circle half around.
The wind here favors me.
I can kick without landing.
Your eyes cannot follow, can they?
I am gauging your reflexes.
You are slower than I assumed.
Do not rush; I am not serious yet.
I lift a leg; only a feint.
Your breathing has scattered again.
Your left side is open.
A roundhouse sweeps at your face.
Three kicks, and you blocked them all.
My toe lands on your chest.
That was only three-tenths of my strength.
I kick the side of your knee.
A ki burst flicks out from my heel.

lines.zh: 一记连踢，落在你的腰侧。
lines.en: A flurry of kicks lands on your flank.
I snap a heel kick at your jaw.
That kick was beautiful, was it not?
Retreat and I stay glued to you.
My leg skims your bracer.
I land one from behind you.
That one is your lesson.

lines.zh: 你的重心偏了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your balance is off; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我用脚跟补上最后一下。
lines.en: I finish it with my heel.
After this kick you will be quiet.

lines.zh: 我从上面落下来，脚尖先着地。
lines.en: I descend and land on my toes.

lines.zh: 这么矮的地方，也配当舞台？
lines.en: So low a place, fit to be a stage?

lines.zh: 我先转个身，让你们看清。
lines.en: Let me turn so you see me properly.
Don Para; remember it.
No mirror here; what a pity.
My cape did not touch the dust.
A good crowd; just right.
Who comes first?
I need no warm-up.
The wind comes from this side; good.

lines.zh: 你们的动作我一眼就看穿。
lines.en: I read your movements at a glance.
I mean to make this fight beautiful.
Small target, small frame.
All of you back up and give me room.
I halt in midair.
Before we begin, look at me closely.

lines.zh: 别拿身高来估我的实力。
lines.en: Do not judge my strength by my height.

lines.zh: 我的脚尖已经贴着地面了。
lines.en: My toes are already on the ground.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到披风，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Flames lick my cape; I slap them out.
My ankle twists as I land.

lines.zh: 水灌进衣领，我挣着往上。
lines.en: Water pours down my collar; I struggle up.

lines.zh: 气浪里，我翻正身子稳住。
lines.en: Inside the blast, I roll upright and hold.
An arrow grazes my shoulder.
That light snarls around my feet.
On an empty stomach I cannot kick fast.
Lightning runs up my leg.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，还想抓点什么。
lines.en: I fall, still reaching for something.
